training_summary: Compare IPOs using issue size, fresh/OFS mix, valuation, margins, debt, promoter holding, subscription and GMP together.
Separate live data from transcript evidence and prefer newer official/current sources.
When a transcript contains conflicting pre/post-issue valuation figures, flag the conflict instead of silently correcting it.
For real-estate IPOs, inspect project pipeline, execution risk, borrowing and concentration of profit in a small number of projects.
For manufacturing IPOs, inspect customer concentration, margins, capex, working-capital/debt and promoter dilution.
